name: Pause Freeze Frame
description: Pause Freeze Frame: zeros motion and audio reactivity so the render loop ticks but produces the same frame every time. Use as a 'still photo' mode — captures the current composition at rest, no beat-sync pulses, no pans, no scale. Pair with the engine's #play toggle to also silence audio. Apply a different preset to resume motion.
